_comment: Canonical historic stats for the TGC Field Register. This file is the source of truth for the 2020-2025 workbook import. The same rows are embedded in index.html so the app works offline; index.html carries a matching HISTORIC_STATS_EXPECTED block and warns on the Stats tab if the two ever drift apart. If you regenerate this file, regenerate that block too.

notes.stand: string; blank where the workbook recorded none
notes.didNotShoot: 1 if the shooter was drawn but did not shoot
notes.estimated: 1 for 2024 rows, where bag counts are the historical average for that property and stand rather than a recorded figure
